title: Project Overview
description: The VoxlBuilder is a web-based damage calculator and build optimizer for the Roblox game 'Voxel Blade'. It lets players configure their character's race, guild, armor, weapons, enchantments, perks, and rings, then computes detailed damage breakdowns across all attack types (M1, M2, Weapon Arts, Runes, Perks). The app is built with Svelte 5, TypeScript, and Vite, and deployed as a static SPA to GitHub Pages.

title: Application Bootstrap
description: The entry chain is index.html -> main.ts -> App.svelte. The HTML file provides a mount target and a module script tag pointing to src/main.ts. That 8-line TypeScript file imports global CSS (app.css with the design system), mounts the root App.svelte component, and initializes Vercel analytics. App.svelte is the 4431-line root component that orchestrates the entire UI: equipment selection modals, enchantment management, drag-and-drop reordering, build state display, tab switching between Overview and Analyze views, and summary statistics.

title: Core Types & State
description: Every module in the engine and data layers depends on src/lib/types.ts (16 dependents — the most-imported file in the project). It defines the fundamental stat system (StatKey, StatMap), equipment interfaces (Race, Guild, Armor, Ring, Rune), weapon component types (WeaponBlade, WeaponHandle, MonkGlove, MonkEssence), the full BuildState interface, proc coefficient handling, and boost system types. src/lib/store.ts builds on these types to provide reactive Svelte stores and updater functions: loading/saving builds to localStorage, setting enchantments and guilds, and moving armor/ring slots between primary and infusion counterparts. Together, types.ts and store.ts form the central state management layer that connects the UI to the calculation engine.

title: The Calculation Engine
description: The engine layer in src/lib/engine/ contains the core damage computation pipeline. build.ts is the main entry point (calcBuild) that accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots, applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, and computes CDR, boosts, and crit. weapon.ts combines blade/handle (or glove/essence for monk) stats, scalings, and damage types, resolving weapon type from combos and applying shrine multipliers. enchant.ts handles the enchantment application engine — stat-selecting enchants, direct modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, infusion (50% stat halving), and exclusive slot enforcement. shrine.ts applies tier-based stat multipliers (up to 3.0x at tier 1). These modules form the data pipeline that the UI components consume.

title: Damage Analysis & Buffs
description: DamageAnalyzer.svelte is the largest file in the project (7015 lines) and the heart of the Analyze tab. It computes full damage breakdowns per attack type (M1, M2, WA, Rune, Perk), applies buff/debuff multipliers, calculates DoT ticks, defense mitigation, weapon charge, scaling breakdowns, self-damage, summon damage, and healing. It imports 28 other modules — the second-highest fan-out in the codebase. BuffList.svelte (783 lines) complements it by computing active buffs from equipped items, perks, weapon arts, and draconic infusion, then displaying them in a tabbed UI (Buffs/Debuffs/Neutral) with potency, duration, and effect descriptions. The buff system is defined in BuffData.ts — a 22-export hub that assembles buffs from all build sources and applies perk-based potency/duration modifiers.

title: Game Data & Constants
description: The src/data/ directory contains game-specific logic modules: weapon arts definitions and validation (weaponArts.ts, Weaponartcheck.ts), damage boost calculations (Boost.ts, TypedDmgBoost.ts, weaponConditionalBoosts.ts), debuff combat effects (debuffCombatEffects.ts, perkAutoDebuffs.ts, enemyHpEffects.ts), draconic rune bonuses (draconicRunes.ts), and self-damage perks (selfDamagePerks.ts). The src/lib/constants/ directory holds the static game constants: damage type metadata (damage-types.ts), core game values like level caps and HP formulas (game.ts), perk constants (perks.ts), boost multipliers (boosts.ts), defensive DR values (defensive.ts), CDR values (cdr.ts), and storage keys (storage.ts). These feed into the engine layer to power the damage calculations.

title: Static Game Data
description: The project includes 11 JSON schema files that define the complete game dataset: perks (perks.json — 3688 lines, the largest data file), armor pieces (armors.json), blades (blades.json), handles (handles.json), essences (essences.json), gloves (gloves.json), rings (rings.json), runes (runes.json), enchantments (enchantments.json), guilds (guilds.json), and races (races.json). Each file contains structured entries with stat bonuses, perk references, scaling parameters, and rarity information. The engine's data accessors in src/lib/engine/data.ts re-export these datasets through a barrel file, providing a single import point for all game data used by the calculation pipeline.

title: Defense, Crit & Damage Types
description: Three specialized modules handle critical combat mechanics. crit.ts computes natural crit chance, extra crit chance, effective crit chance, and crit damage multiplier from stats and perks, with Primal division and proc coefficient scaling. defense.ts resolves defense sources (percent-based and flat) into damage type multipliers, groups damage types by which defense stats apply, and computes total base armor defense. damageTypeResolve.ts resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions into numeric type maps, applies type bonuses, and handles conversions (Fire<->Air via Echo Incineration, Air->Magic via Spirit Winds, Dark Magic hex bonus). dmgTypeBonuses.ts calculates elemental/magical damage type bonuses from perks. These modules are consumed by DamageAnalyzer.svelte to produce the final damage numbers.

title: Build Saves & Persistence
description: BuildSaves.svelte (1098 lines, 27 fan-out) manages the full build lifecycle: localStorage persistence of up to 5 build slots, import/export with deflate compression and base64 encoding, drag-to-reorder slot management, fuzzy search across saved builds, duplicate detection, and build state serialization with key mapping and sanitization. The storage constants in src/lib/constants/storage.ts define all localStorage keys, default build values, and serialization mappings (SAVE_KEY_MAP/UNMAP, ENCH_MAP/UNMAP). This persistence layer lets users save, compare, and share their optimized builds.

title: CI/CD & Deployment
description: The project deploys to both GitHub Pages and Vercel. The GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/static.yml) builds the Vite project on push to main, then deploys the dist/ directory to GitHub Pages via actions/deploy-pages. vercel.json configures SPA rewrites and hosting headers for the Vercel deployment. vite.config.ts configures the Svelte plugin, VitePWA for PWA support with auto-update, and rollup-plugin-visualizer for bundle analysis. package.json defines the build scripts (vite for dev, vite build for production) and lists key dependencies: svelte ^5.55.4, vite ^8.10, typescript ~6.0.2.
